facts.fact: Village de la Justice says Gabon's ordinance n°0011/PR/2026, signed 26 February 2026 and published in Journal Officiel n°110 of 8-15 April 2026, bans sexual deepfakes without consent and deepfakes attributing false statements to public figures, with a right to report and removal within 24 hours.

Village de la Justice says ordinance n°0013/PR/2026 gives the Haute Autorité de la Communication (HAC) express competence to regulate digital platforms, and that the HAC is given the task of auditing AI systems.

GAB.note: Document states nothing on government use of AI.

facts.fact: Village de la Justice says the Haute Autorité de la Communication suspended access to Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp across Gabon, nine days before the 26 February 2026 ordinances, without express legal basis.
